title: PR event
description: What intake publishes on the pr-events topic (riffle-<environment>-pr-events in GCP) and the scorer consumes: one pull request trigger, with its signature verified and duplicates dropped. Carries identifiers only, never code or the GitHub payload; the scorer reads the rest itself, pinned to head_sha. The ordering key is <tenant_id>/<repo>#<pr_number>, so the events of one PR arrive in order.

delivery_id.description: GitHub's X-GitHub-Delivery header. When one delivery names several PRs (a check suite), intake publishes one event per PR and appends :<pr_number>. Scoring is idempotent on this value

action.description: What triggered the event. Covers every trigger rescore.on can enable; ci_completed is mapped from a completed check suite

head_sha.description: Head commit of the PR when the event happened

received_at.description: When intake verified the delivery, RFC 3339 in UTC
